answer_text: For IPsec sites with bandwidth of 100 Mbps or more, use only the AES 128 GCM-16 or AES 256 GCM-16 algorithms. AES CBC algorithms are only recommended for sites with bandwidth below 100 Mbps. GCM encryption is more efficient and scalable, providing better performance and reliability for high-throughput encrypted traffic; also make sure both peers use the same algorithm to minimize tunnel establishment time.
